title.zh: 卷五十三 列傳第二十三 愍懷太子
title.raw: 卷五十三 列傳第二十三 愍懷太子 Volume 53 Biographies 23: Crown Prince Minhuai

units.zh: 湣懷太子遹，字熙祖，惠帝長子，母曰謝才人。
units.literal: Crown Prince Minhuai, Yu, courtesy name Xizu, was Emperor Hui's eldest son; his mother was Talented Lady Xie.
units.idiomatic: Crown Prince Minhuai, Yu, courtesy name Xizu, was Emperor Hui's eldest son; his mother was Talented Lady Xie.

units.zh: 幼而聰慧，武帝愛之，恆在左右。
units.literal: From childhood he was clever and bright; Emperor Wu loved him and kept him always at his side.
units.idiomatic: From childhood he was clever and bright; Emperor Wu loved him and kept him always at his side.

units.zh: 嘗與諸皇子共戲殿上，惠帝來朝，執諸皇子手，次至太子，帝曰：「是汝兒也。」
units.literal: Once he was playing in the palace hall with the imperial princes; when Emperor Hui came to audience he took each prince's hand in turn; when he reached the crown prince, Emperor Wu said, 'This is your son.'
units.idiomatic: Once he was playing in the palace hall with the imperial princes; when Emperor Hui came to audience he took each prince's hand in turn; when he reached the crown prince, Emperor Wu said, 'This is your son.'

units.zh: 惠帝乃止。
units.literal: Emperor Hui thereupon stopped.
units.idiomatic: Emperor Hui thereupon stopped.

units.zh: 宮中嘗夜失火，武帝登樓望之。
units.literal: Once at night the palace caught fire; Emperor Wu climbed a tower to watch.
units.idiomatic: Once at night the palace caught fire; Emperor Wu climbed a tower to watch.

units.zh: 太子時年五歲，牽帝裾入暗中。
units.literal: The crown prince was then five years old; he tugged the emperor's robe into the shadows.
units.idiomatic: The crown prince was then five years old; he tugged the emperor's robe into the shadows.

units.zh: 帝問其故，太子曰：「暮夜倉卒，宜備非常，不宜令照見人君也。」
units.literal: The emperor asked why; the crown prince said, 'Suddenly at night one should guard against the unexpected; one must not let firelight reveal the ruler's face.'
units.idiomatic: The emperor asked why; the crown prince said, 'Suddenly at night one should guard against the unexpected; one must not let firelight reveal the ruler's face.'

units.zh: 由是奇之。
units.literal: From this Wu Di marveled at him.
units.idiomatic: Wu Di marked him extraordinary.

units.zh: 嘗從帝觀豕牢，言於帝曰：「豕甚肥，何不殺以享士，而使久費五穀？」
units.literal: Once when following the emperor to view the pig pen he said to the emperor, 'The pigs are very fat—why not slaughter them to feast the troops instead of letting them waste grain forever?'
units.idiomatic: Once when following the emperor to view the pig pen he said to the emperor, "The pigs are very fat—why not slaughter them to feast the troops instead of letting them waste grain forever?"

units.zh: 帝嘉其意，即使烹之。
units.literal: The emperor praised his intent and at once ordered them cooked.
units.idiomatic: The emperor praised his intent and at once ordered them cooked.

units.zh: 及賈庶人死，乃誅劉振、孫慮、程據等，冊復太子曰：「皇帝使使持節、兼司空、衛尉伊策故皇太子之靈曰：嗚呼！
units.literal: When Deposed Commoner Jia died, they executed Liu Zhen, Sun Lü, Cheng Ju, and others, and posthumously restored the crown prince; the edict read: 'The emperor dispatches the credential-bearer, concurrent Director of Works, Commandant of the Guard Yi to announce by patent to the spirit of the late crown prince: Alas!
units.idiomatic: When Deposed Commoner Jia died, they executed Liu Zhen, Sun Lü, Cheng Ju, and others, and posthumously restored the crown prince; the edict read: "The emperor dispatches the credential-bearer, concurrent Director of Works, Commandant of the Guard Yi to announce by patent to the spirit of the late crown prince: Alas!

units.zh: 維爾少資岐嶷之質，荷先帝殊異之寵，大啟土宇，奄有淮陵。
units.literal: In youth you were endowed with precocious wisdom and enjoyed the late emperor’s exceptional affection. He granted you a great domain and possession of Huailing.
units.idiomatic: In youth you were endowed with precocious wisdom and enjoyed the late emperor’s exceptional affection. He granted you a great domain and possession of Huailing.

units.zh: 朕奉遵遺旨，越建爾儲副，以光顯我祖宗。
units.literal: I followed his last wishes and established you as heir, to glorify our ancestors.
units.idiomatic: I followed his last wishes and established you as heir, to glorify our ancestors.

units.zh: 既表髫齔，高明逸秀。
units.literal: Already in tied hair you stood lofty and bright.
units.idiomatic: Even in early boyhood you displayed lofty brilliance and exceptional talents.

units.zh: 昔爾聖祖，嘉爾淑美。
units.literal: Your holy ancestor prized your fine virtue.
units.idiomatic: Your august grandfather cherished your fine virtues.

units.zh: 顯詔仍崇，名振同軌。
units.literal: Illustrious edicts repeatedly increased your honors; your fame resounded throughout the realm.
units.idiomatic: Illustrious edicts repeatedly increased your honors; your fame resounded throughout the realm.

units.zh: 史臣曰：湣懷挺岐嶷之姿，表夙成之質。
units.literal: The historiographers say: Minhuai bore a posture keen and wise, displaying precocious substance.
units.idiomatic: The historiographers say: Minhuai was endowed with exceptional wisdom and displayed precocious gifts.

units.zh: 武皇鍾愛，既深詒厥之謀；
units.literal: Emperor Wu cherished him and deeply laid succession plans.
units.idiomatic: Emperor Wu cherished him and deeply laid succession plans.

units.zh: 天下歸心，頗有後來之望。
units.literal: All under Heaven turned hearts toward him—high hopes attended his future.
units.idiomatic: All under Heaven turned hearts toward him—high hopes attended his future.

units.zh: 贊曰：湣懷聰穎，諒惟天挺。
units.literal: The encomium says: Minhuai clever and keen—truly Heaven-endowed.
units.idiomatic: The encomium says: Minhuai was intelligent and perceptive, truly endowed by Heaven.

units.zh: 皇祖鐘心，庶僚引領。
units.literal: Imperial ancestor pinned hope on him; hosts of officials craned necks.
units.idiomatic: His imperial grandfather cherished him deeply; the assembled officials looked forward in expectation.

units.zh: 震宮肇建，儲德不恢。
units.literal: When Thunder Palace first rose, heir virtue never broadened.
units.idiomatic: When he first entered the heir’s palace, his princely virtue failed to grow.

title.zh: 卷12 志第7 禮儀七
title.raw: 卷12 志第7 禮儀七 Volume 12 Treatises 7: Rites 7

units.zh: 臣子之道，義無上逼。
units.literal: The way of subject and son—in principle there is no surpassing the superior.
units.idiomatic: The way of subject and son—in principle there is no surpassing the superior.

units.zh: 故晉武帝太始三年，詔太宰安平王孚著侍內之服，四年，又賜趙、燕、樂安王等散騎常侍之服。
units.literal: Thus in the third year of Taishi under Emperor Wu of Jin, an edict ordered Grand Preceptor Prince of Peace Wang Fu to wear attendant inner dress; in the fourth year, Zhao, Yan, and Prince of Le'an were also bestowed irregular attendant dress.
units.idiomatic: Thus in the third year of Taishi under Emperor Wu of Jin, an edict ordered Grand Preceptor Prince of Peace Wang Fu to wear attendant inner dress; in the fourth year, Zhao, Yan, and Prince of Le'an were also bestowed irregular attendant dress.

units.zh: 自斯以後，台鼎貴臣，並加貂璫武弁，故皇太子遂著遠遊，謙不逼尊，於理為允。」
units.literal: From then on, high ministers of the Secretariat all added sable earring military caps; thus the crown prince wore far-wandering cap, humble and not surpassing the superior—in principle this is acceptable.
units.idiomatic: From then on, high ministers of the Secretariat all added sable earring military caps; thus the crown prince wore far-wandering cap, humble and not surpassing the superior—in principle this is acceptable."

units.zh: 後文帝以神元春秋已高，求歸。
units.literal: Later Wen Emperor, because Shenyuan's years were already advanced, requested to return.
units.idiomatic: Later, seeing Shenyuan's great age, Shamohan asked leave to go home.

units.zh: 晉武帝具禮護送。
units.literal: Emperor Wu of Jin treated him with full rites and escorted him on his way.
units.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Jin honored him with full ceremony and sent him homeward under escort.

units.zh: 五十六年，文帝復如晉，其冬還國。
units.literal: In the fifty-sixth year Wen Emperor again went to Jin; that winter he returned to his state.
units.idiomatic: In the fifty-sixth year he visited Jin again and came back that winter.

title.zh: 卷三 帝紀第三 世祖武帝
title.raw: 卷三 帝紀第三 世祖武帝 Volume 3 Annals 3: Emperor Wu

units.zh: 八年春正月，監軍何楨討匈奴劉猛，累破之，左部帥李恪殺猛而降。
units.literal: In the eighth year, spring, first month, army supervisor He Zhen campaigned against the Xiongnu Liu Meng, repeatedly defeated him, and Li Ke, leader of the left wing, killed Meng and surrendered.
units.idiomatic: Eighth year, spring, first month: He Zhen campaigned against the Xiongnu Liu Meng until Li Ke, leader of the left wing, killed Meng and surrendered.

units.zh: 癸亥，帝耕于藉田。
units.literal: On the day guihai the emperor ploughed the sacred field.
units.idiomatic: On guihai he turned the soil of the ritual field.

units.zh: 二月乙亥，禁彫文綺組非法之物。
units.literal: On the day yihai of the second month carved patterns and illegal brocade weaves were forbidden.
units.idiomatic: Second month, yihai: luxury embroidery and illegal weave patterns were banned.

units.zh: 詔內外群官舉任邊郡者各三人。
units.literal: He ordered civil and military officials within and without each to recommend three men fit to serve on frontier commanderies.
units.idiomatic: Every office had to name three candidates willing to serve on the border.

units.zh: 帝與右將軍皇甫陶論事，陶與帝爭言，散騎常侍鄭徽表請罪之。
units.literal: The emperor discussed affairs with general of the right Huangfu Tao; Tao disputed with the emperor in speech, and Zheng Hui, regular attendant of cavalier, memorialized requesting to punish Tao.
units.idiomatic: Huangfu Tao argued loudly with the throne; Zheng Hui asked that Tao be prosecuted.

units.zh: 帝曰：「讜言謇諤，所望於左右也。
units.literal: The emperor said: “Straightforward counsel in blunt words is what I expect from those at my side.
units.idiomatic: The emperor replied, “I want blunt counsel from my attendants.

units.zh: 人主常以阿媚爲患，豈以爭臣爲損哉！
units.literal: A ruler always takes flattery as the peril; how could contending ministers be a loss!
units.idiomatic: Flattery ruins a throne; honest quarrel does not.

units.zh: 十一月丁酉，臨宣武觀大閱諸軍，甲辰乃罷。
units.literal: On the day dingyou of the eleventh month he attended the Xuanwu review stand to inspect the armies in grand review; on jiachen it ended.
units.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dingyou: he watched a full army parade at Xuanwu Gate until jiachen.

units.zh: 十年春正月辛亥，帝耕于藉田。
units.literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on the day xinhai, the emperor ploughed the sacred field.
units.idiomatic: Tenth year, spring, xinhai: another ploughing rite.

units.zh: 閏月癸酉，太傅、壽光公鄭沖薨。
units.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day guiyou, Zheng Chong, grand tutor and duke of Shouguang, died.
units.idiomatic: Intercalary guiyou: grand tutor Zheng Chong died.

units.zh: 冬十一月，立城東七里澗石橋。
units.literal: In winter, the eleventh month they erected a stone bridge over the seven-li gully east of the city.
units.idiomatic: Winter: a stone span was built east of Luoyang over the Seven-li Ditch.

units.zh: 庚午，帝臨宣武觀，大閱諸軍。
units.literal: On the day gengwu the emperor attended the Xuanwu review stand and held a grand review of the armies.
units.idiomatic: On gengwu he reviewed the hosts at Xuanwu Gate.

units.zh: 十二月，有星孛于軫。
units.literal: In the twelfth month a broom star appeared in the asterism Zhen.
units.idiomatic: In the twelfth month: a comet trailed through Zhen.

title.zh: 卷三十 志第二十 刑法
title.raw: 卷三十 志第二十 刑法 Volume 30 Treatises 20: Punishment and Law

units.zh: 自茲厥後，狙詐彌繁。
units.literal: From this onward, cunning and deceit grew ever more numerous.
units.idiomatic: Afterward schemes multiplied faster than the law could track.

units.zh: 武皇帝並以為往憲猶疑，不可經國，乃命車騎將軍、守尚書令、魯公徵求英俊，刊律定篇云爾。
units.literal: Emperor Wu altogether considered that past statutes still had doubts and could not order the state; then he ordered the chariot-and-cavalry general, acting director of the Secretariat, Duke of Lu, to gather outstanding men, carve the statutes and fix the chapters—thus.
units.idiomatic: Emperor Wu decided Han-Wei precedent was too muddled to govern by and ordered the chariot general, acting Secretariat chief, and Duke of Lu to recruit jurists and engrave a definitive code—that story follows.

units.zh: 漢自王莽篡位之後，舊章不存。
units.literal: Han after Wang Mang usurped the throne, old regulations did not survive.
units.idiomatic: After Wang Mang seized the Han throne, the classical statutes barely survived.

title.zh: 卷三 帝紀第三 世祖武帝
title.raw: 卷三 帝紀第三 世祖武帝 Volume 3 Annals 3: Emperor Wu

units.zh: 三年春正月癸丑，白龍二見于弘農、澠池。
units.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on the day guichou, two white dragons were seen at Hongnong and Mianchi.
units.idiomatic: the third year of Taishi, spring, guichou: twin white dragons were sighted at Hongnong and Mianchi.

units.zh: 丁卯，[6]立皇子衷爲皇太子。
units.literal: On the day dingmao [6] the imperial son Zhong was established as crown prince.
units.idiomatic: On dingmao [6] Sima Zhong was named heir apparent.

units.zh: 詔曰：「朕以不德，託于四海之上，兢兢祗畏，懼無以康濟宇內，思與天下式明王度，正本清源，於置胤樹嫡，非所先務。
units.literal: An edict said: “I, lacking in virtue, rely on the realm above me; fearful and reverent, I worry that I cannot bring peace within the four seas, and I wish together with all under heaven to clarify the kingly norms, rectify the root and cleanse the source; as for establishing heirs and fixing the legitimate line, that is not the foremost task at present.
units.idiomatic: The edict said: “I, lacking virtue, have been entrusted with a place above the four seas. Anxious and reverent, I fear I have no means to bring peace and rescue to all within the realm, and I wish together with all under Heaven to make clear the royal standards, rectify the root, and clear the source. As for establishing an heir and setting up the legitimate line, that is not the first task.

units.zh: 有星孛于軫。
units.literal: A broom star appeared in the asterism Zhen.
units.idiomatic: A comet blazed across the Zhen mansion in the sky.

units.zh: 丁亥，帝耕於藉田。
units.literal: On the day dinghai the emperor ploughed the sacred field.
units.idiomatic: On dinghai the Son of Heaven broke the soil of the ritual field.

units.zh: 戊子，詔曰：「古設象刑而眾不犯，今雖參夷而姦不絕，何德刑相去之遠哉！
units.literal: On the day wuzi an edict said: “In antiquity symbolic punishments were set up yet the multitude did not offend; now though we extend punishment to three kinships wickedness does not cease—how far apart are virtue and punishment!
units.idiomatic: On wuzi he mused: “When the ancients set up symbolic punishments, the multitude did not offend; today we slaughter whole clans yet treason persists—what has become of moral government?

units.literal: Han Guangwu does not succeed Xiaocheng but receives above from Emperor Yuan.
units.idiomatic: Han's Guangwu does not follow Xiaocheng but inherits from Emperor Yuan.

units.zh: 又曰：『晉惠帝無後，懷帝承統，懷帝自繼于世祖，而不繼于惠帝。
units.literal: Also: 'Jin Emperor Hui had no heir; Emperor Huai received the succession; Huai succeeded himself from Shizu, not from Emperor Hui.

units.zh: 其惠帝當同陽甲、孝成，別出為廟。』
units.literal: Emperor Hui should be the same as Yang Jia and Xiaocheng, separately enshrined outside.
units.idiomatic: Hui should join Yang Jia and Xiaocheng in a separate shrine.

units.zh: 君意何如？」
units.literal: What is your intent?"
units.idiomatic: What do you counsel?"

units.zh: 元海曰：「殿下武皇帝之子，有殊勳於王室，威恩光洽，四海欽風，孰不思為殿下沒命投軀者哉，何難發之有乎！
units.literal: Yuanhai said, "Your Highness is Martial Emperor's son and has extraordinary merit toward the royal house; awe and kindness shine everywhere, and the four seas admire your wind—who would not think to die and cast aside his body for Your Highness—what difficulty is there in mobilizing them!
units.idiomatic: Liu Yuan answered, "You are Sima Yan's son, beloved across the realm—every warrior would die for you; raising the tribes is no hard task.

units.zh: 王浚豎子，東嬴疏屬，豈能與殿下爭衡邪！
units.literal: Wang Jun is a stripling; Dongying is a distant cousin—how can they match Your Highness!
units.idiomatic: Wang Jun is a pup and Sima Teng a cadet branch—neither can rival you.

units.literal: The emperor accepted it, and only then were the offices established.

units.literal: In the first year of Taishi his fief was changed to Marquis of Xi'e county.
units.idiomatic: In 265 his title was transferred to marquis of Xi'e county.

units.zh: 宪遣妻子居洛阳，武帝以子袭为给事中。
units.literal: Xian sent wife and children to dwell at Luoyang; Emperor Wu appointed his son Xi as palace attendant.
units.idiomatic: He moved his family to Luoyang, and Emperor Wu of Jin gave his son Luo Xi a post as palace attendant.

units.zh: 三年冬，入朝，进位冠军将军、假节。
units.literal: In the third year, winter, he entered court, was advanced in rank to General Who Vanquishes Champions, and granted credentials.
units.idiomatic: In the winter of 267 he attended court and was promoted to general who vanquishes champions with ceremonial credentials.

units.zh: 四年三月，从帝宴于华林园，诏问蜀大臣子弟，后问先辈宜时叙用者，宪荐蜀郡常忌、杜轸、寿良、巴西陈寿、南郡高轨、南阳吕雅、许国、江夏费恭、琅邪诸葛京、汝南陈裕，即皆叙用，咸显於世。
units.literal: In the fourth year, third month, he followed the Emperor feasting in Hualin Garden; an edict asked about sons and younger brothers of Shu great ministers, afterward asking which elders of former times should be employed in due season; Xian recommended Chang Ji of Shu commandery, Du Zhen, Shou Liang, Chen Shou of Baxi, Gao Gui of Nan commandery, Lü Ya, Xu Guo, Fei Gong of Jiangxia, Zhuge Jing of Langye, Chen Yu of Runan; all were at once employed in order, all illustrious in the age.
units.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year, he attended the emperor’s banquet in Hualin Park. An edict asked about the sons and younger brothers of Shu’s great ministers, and then about senior men of the previous generation who ought now to be appointed. Luo Xian recommended Chang Ji of Shu Commandery, Du Zhen, Shou Liang, Chen Shou of Baxi, Gao Gui of Nan Commandery, Lü Ya and Xu Guo of Nanyang, Fei Gong of Jiangxia, Zhuge Jing of Langye, and Chen Yu of Runan; all were appointed and all became prominent in their time.

units.zh: 宪还，袭取吴之巫城，因上伐吴之策。
units.literal: Xian returned, raided and took Wu's Wucheng, and thereupon submitted a plan to attack Wu.
units.idiomatic: When he came back he struck east, captured the Wu outpost at Wucheng, and followed with a memorial urging a campaign against Wu.

units.zh: 乙卯，詔曰：「比年災異屢發，日蝕三朝，地震山崩。
units.literal: On the day yimao an edict said: “In recent years omens have repeatedly appeared—three court mornings with solar eclipses, earthquakes and mountain collapses.
units.idiomatic: On yimao, an edict said, "In recent years disasters and anomalies have repeatedly occurred: solar eclipses in three courts, earthquakes, and mountain collapses.

units.zh: 邦之不臧，實在朕躬。
units.literal: When the state is not good, the fault is truly in my person.
units.idiomatic: When the realm falters, the blame lies with me alone.

units.zh: 公卿大臣各上封事，極言其故，勿有所諱。」
units.literal: Let each duke and minister submit a sealed memorial, speaking to the utmost of the reasons, and let none hold back.”
units.idiomatic: I want sealed memorials from every minister, candid and complete.”

units.zh: 遂與崇，建皆族誅，籍沒崇家。
units.literal: Thereupon Yue, Chong, and Jian were all executed to the clan, and Chong's property was confiscated.
units.idiomatic: Yue, Chong, and Jian were executed to the clan, and Chong's estate was confiscated.

units.zh: 相國倫收淮南王母弟吳王晏，欲殺之。
units.literal: Chancellor Lun arrested the Prince of Wu Yan, the Prince of Huainan's younger brother by the same mother, intending to kill him.
units.idiomatic: Lun arrested Yan, Prince of Wu, Yun's younger brother by the same mother, intending to kill him.

units.zh: 光祿大夫傅祗爭之於朝堂，眾皆諫止倫，倫乃貶晏為賓徒縣王。
units.literal: The Household Grandee Fu Zhi contended for him in the court hall; all remonstrated and stopped Lun, and Lun thereupon degraded Yan to Prince of Bintu county.
units.idiomatic: Household Grandee Fu Zhi argued for him in court; all remonstrated, and Lun degraded Yan to Prince of Bintu.

units.zh: 齊王冏以功遷游擊將軍，冏意不滿，有恨色。
units.literal: The Prince of Qi Jiong was transferred to General of the Reserves for his merit, but Jiong was dissatisfied and showed resentment.
units.idiomatic: Jiong was promoted to General of the Reserves for his merit but was dissatisfied and showed resentment.

units.literal: Note [2] Wansui Pavilion is northwest of the old Songyang county in modern Luo prefecture.
units.idiomatic: Note [2]: Wansui Post stood northwest of old Songyang.

units.zh: 武帝元封元年，幸緱氏，登太室，聞山上呼萬歲聲者三，因以名焉。
units.literal: In the first year of Yuanfeng under Emperor Wu of Han, the emperor visited Goushi, climbed Taishi, and heard cries of "long life" three times from the mountain; he therefore named the place Wansui.
units.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanfeng under Emperor Wu of Han, the emperor visited Goushi, climbed Taishi, and heard cries of "long life" three times from the mountain; he therefore named the place Wansui.

units.zh: 注[三]論語孔子曰，伯夷、叔齊不降其志，不辱其身。

units.idiomatic: Note [3]: the Analects praises Boyi and Shuqi for never debasing their purpose or person.

title.zh: 齊悼惠王世家
title.en: House of Prince Daohui of Qi
title.raw: 《齊悼惠王世家》 House of Prince Daohui of Qi

units.zh: 主父偃由此亦與齊有卻。
units.literal: Zhu Fu Yan thus also had grievances with Qi.
units.idiomatic: Because of this, Zhu Fu Yan also bore a grudge against Qi.

units.zh: 主父偃方幸於天子，用事，因言：「齊臨菑十萬戶，市租千金，人眾殷富，巨於長安，此非天子親弟愛子不得王此。
units.literal: Zhu Fu Yan was currently favored by the Son of Heaven and held power. He thus spoke: 'Qi's Linzi has a hundred thousand households, market rents of a thousand jin, the people are numerous and wealthy, greater than Chang'an. This is not a place for anyone but the Son of Heaven's own younger brother or beloved son to rule.
units.idiomatic: Zhu Fu Yan, who at that time enjoyed the Son of Heaven's favor and wielded great influence, remarked: 'Linzi in Qi has a hundred thousand households. Its market revenues amount to a thousand jin. Its population is vast and its wealth surpasses that of Chang'an itself. No one but the Son of Heaven's own brother or beloved son should be allowed to rule such a place.

units.zh: 今齊王於親屬益疏。」
units.literal: Now the King of Qi is increasingly distant in kinship.'
units.idiomatic: Yet the present King of Qi grows ever more remote in kinship from the throne.'

units.zh: 今聞齊王與其姊亂。」
units.literal: Now I hear the King of Qi is committing incest with his sister.'
units.idiomatic: And now I hear the King of Qi is carrying on an incestuous affair with his own sister.'

units.zh: 於是天子乃拜主父偃為齊相，且正其事。
units.literal: Thus, the Son of Heaven appointed Zhu Fu Yan as Qi chancellor, and moreover to investigate this matter.
units.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven thereupon appointed Zhu Fu Yan as chancellor of Qi to investigate the matter and bring it to justice.

units.zh: 主父偃既至齊，乃急治王後宮宦者為王通於姊翁主所者，令其辭證皆引王。
units.literal: Zhu Fu Yan having arrived in Qi, urgently interrogated the eunuchs in the king's rear palace who arranged the king's liaisons with his sister Princess Ji, commanding their testimonies and evidence to all implicate the king.
units.idiomatic: Upon arriving in Qi, Zhu Fu Yan swiftly interrogated the eunuchs of the inner palace who had facilitated the King's liaisons with his sister, the Princess, compelling all their testimony and evidence to implicate the King.

units.zh: 是時趙王懼主父偃一出廢齊，恐其漸疏骨肉，乃上書言偃受金及輕重之短。
units.literal: At this time the King of Zhao feared that Zhu Fu Yan, having once deposed Qi, would gradually alienate the royal kin. He submitted a memorial speaking of Yan's receiving gold and his faults of weighing lightly and heavily.
units.idiomatic: At this time, the King of Zhao, alarmed that Zhu Fu Yan had engineered the downfall of Qi and might gradually turn the throne against the rest of the imperial family, submitted a memorial accusing Yan of accepting bribes and abusing his authority.

units.zh: 天子亦既囚偃。
units.literal: The Son of Heaven also imprisoned Yan.
units.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven had Zhu Fu Yan imprisoned.

units.zh: 公孫弘言：「齊王以憂死毋後，國入漢，非誅偃無以塞天下之望。」
units.literal: Gongsun Hong spoke: 'The King of Qi died of sorrow without descendants, the state reverted to Han. Not executing Yan will not satisfy the realm's expectations.'
units.idiomatic: Gongsun Hong declared, 'The King of Qi died in anguish, leaving no heir, and his kingdom has reverted to the Han. Unless Zhu Fu Yan is put to death, the expectations of the realm will not be satisfied.'

units.zh: 菑川地比齊。
units.literal: Zichuan territory bordered Qi.
units.idiomatic: Zichuan's territory lay adjacent to Qi.

units.zh: 天子憐齊，為悼惠王冢園在郡，割臨菑東環悼惠王冢園邑盡以予菑川，以奉悼惠王祭祀。
units.literal: The Son of Heaven pitied Qi and, because King Daohui's tomb and garden were in the commandery, carved out the settlements east of Linzi encircling King Daohui's tomb and garden and gave them all to Zichuan to maintain King Daohui's sacrifices.
units.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven took pity on Qi. Since King Daohui's tomb and park lay within the commandery, he carved out all the settlements east of Linzi that encircled the tomb and granted them to Zichuan, so that the sacrifices to King Daohui might continue.

units.zh: 城陽景王章，齊悼惠王子，以朱虛侯與大臣共誅諸呂，而章身首先斬相國呂王產於未央宮。
units.literal: King Jing of Chengyang Zhang, a son of King Daohui of Qi, as Marquis Zhuxu together with the ministers commonly executed the various Lü, and Zhang himself was the first to behead Chancellor King Lü Chan in Weiyang Palace.
units.idiomatic: Zhang, King Jing of Chengyang, was a son of King Daohui of Qi. As the Marquis of Zhuxu, he joined with the great ministers to destroy the Lü clan, and it was Zhang himself who first struck down the Chancellor Lü Chan in the Weiyang Palace.

units.zh: 六月戊辰，大赦，增吏位二等。
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the wuchen day, a general amnesty; officials’ ranks were increased two grades.
units.idiomatic: The wuchen day in the sixth month brought a general amnesty and a two-grade promotion for every official.

units.zh: 復封賓徒王晏爲吳王。
units.literal: Prince Yan of Bintu was again enfeoffed as prince of Wu.
units.idiomatic: Prince Yan of Bintu was restored to the old Wu princedom.

units.zh: 庚午，東萊王蕤、左衛將軍王輿謀廢齊王冏，事泄，蕤廢爲庶人，輿伏誅，夷三族。
units.literal: On the gengwu day, Prince Rui of Donglai and General of the Left Guards Wang Yu plotted to depose Prince Jiong of Qi; the affair leaked; Rui was deposed to commoner status; Yu submitted to execution; three clans were exterminated.
units.idiomatic: Prince Rui of Donglai and Wang Yu conspired to topple Prince Jiong; when the plot surfaced, Rui was reduced to commoner rank while Wang Yu and three degrees of his kin were executed.

units.zh: 封齊王冏功臣葛旟牟平公，路季小黃公，衛毅平陰公，劉真安鄉公，韓泰封丘公。
units.literal: Prince Jiong of Qi’s meritorious subjects Ge Yu was enfeoffed duke of Mouping, Lu Ji duke of Xiaohuang, Wei Yi duke of Pingyin, Liu Zhen duke of Anxiang, and Han Tai duke of Fengqiu.
units.idiomatic: Prince Jiong of Qi's meritorious followers were enfeoffed: Ge Yu as Duke of Mouping, Lu Ji as Duke of Xiaohuang, Wei Yi as Duke of Pingyin, Liu Zhen as Duke of Anxiang, and Han Tai as Duke of Fengqiu.

units.zh: 秋七月甲午，立吳王晏子國爲漢王，復封常山王乂爲長沙王。
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the jiawu day, Prince Yan of Wu’s son Guo was established as prince of Han; Prince Yi of Changshan was again enfeoffed as prince of Changsha.
units.idiomatic: On the jiawu day in the seventh month Sima Guo, son of Prince Yan of Wu, was created prince of Han, and Prince Yi was moved back from Changshan to the Changsha princedom.

units.zh: 八月，大赦。
units.literal: In the eighth month, a general amnesty.
units.idiomatic: A general amnesty was declared in the eighth month.

title.zh: 東越列傳
title.raw: 《東越列傳》 Treatise on the Eastern Yue

units.zh: 至建元三年，閩越發兵圍東甌。
units.literal: In the third year of the Jianyuan era, Minyue dispatched troops to besiege Dong'ou.
units.idiomatic: In the third year of the Jianyuan era, the Minyue sent their army to lay siege to Dong'ou.

units.zh: 東甌食盡，困，且降，乃使人告急天子。
units.literal: Dong'ou's food supplies were exhausted, they were in dire straits, and on the verge of surrender, so they sent envoys to urgently appeal to the Son of Heaven.
units.idiomatic: Dong'ou's provisions ran out. Desperate and on the brink of surrender, they dispatched envoys to make an urgent appeal to the emperor.

units.zh: 天子問太尉田蚡，蚡對曰：「越人相攻擊，固其常，又數反覆，不足以煩中國往救也。
units.literal: The Son of Heaven consulted Grand Commandant Tian Fen. Fen replied: 'The Yue people attacking each other is simply their custom; moreover, they have been fickle time and again, so it is not worth troubling the Middle Kingdom to go rescue them.
units.idiomatic: The emperor consulted Grand Commandant Tian Fen, who replied: 'The Yue attacking one another is simply their custom. They have been fickle time and again, and it is hardly worth troubling the Middle Kingdom to send troops to rescue them.

units.zh: 自秦時棄弗屬。」
units.literal: Since the time of Qin, they have been abandoned and not governed.'
units.idiomatic: They have been beyond our domain since the days of Qin.'

units.zh: 且秦舉咸陽而棄之，何乃越也！
units.literal: Moreover, Qin abandoned even Xianyang itself—how much less should we fuss about Yue!
units.idiomatic: Moreover, Qin abandoned even Xianyang itself—how much less should we trouble ourselves over Yue!

units.zh: 今小國以窮困來告急天子，天子弗振，彼當安所告愬？
units.literal: Now a small kingdom comes in desperation to urgently appeal to the Son of Heaven; if the Son of Heaven does not come to its aid, where else shall they turn to plead their case?
units.idiomatic: Now a small kingdom, driven to desperation, has come to plead with the emperor. If the emperor refuses to act, where else are they to turn?

units.zh: 又何以子萬國乎？」
units.literal: And how then can we serve as parent to the ten thousand kingdoms?'
units.idiomatic: And how then can we claim to be a parent to the myriad kingdoms?'

units.zh: 上曰：「太尉未足與計。
units.literal: The emperor said: 'The Grand Commandant is not one to plan with.
units.idiomatic: The emperor said: 'The Grand Commandant is not fit to be consulted on this matter.

units.zh: 吾初即位，不欲出虎符發兵郡國。」
units.literal: I have only just ascended the throne and do not wish to issue tiger tallies to mobilize troops from the commanderies and kingdoms.'
units.idiomatic: I have only just come to the throne, and I am reluctant to issue the tiger tallies to mobilize the armies of the commanderies and kingdoms.'

units.zh: 至建元六年，閩越擊南越。
units.literal: In the sixth year of the Jianyuan era, Minyue attacked Nanyue.
units.idiomatic: In the sixth year of the Jianyuan era, the Minyue launched an attack on Nanyue.

units.zh: 南越守天子約，不敢擅發兵擊而以聞。
units.literal: Nanyue observed the Son of Heaven's covenant and did not dare to send troops on its own to counterattack, but instead reported the matter.
units.idiomatic: Nanyue honored its covenant with the emperor and refrained from retaliating on its own, choosing instead to report the aggression to the court.

units.zh: 上遣大行王恢出豫章，大農韓安國出會稽，皆為將軍。
units.literal: The emperor dispatched the Grand Herald Wang Hui from Yuzhang and the Grand Minister of Agriculture Han Anguo from Kuaiji, both serving as generals.
units.idiomatic: The emperor sent the Grand Herald Wang Hui forth from Yuzhang and the Grand Minister of Agriculture Han Anguo from Kuaiji, each to serve as a commanding general.

units.zh: 兵未踰嶺，閩越王郢發兵距險。
units.literal: Before the troops had crossed the mountain ranges, the King of Minyue, Ying, dispatched troops to hold the defiles.
units.idiomatic: Before the Han armies had even crossed the mountain passes, King Ying of Minyue sent his own troops to fortify the defiles.

units.zh: 其弟餘善乃與相、宗族謀曰：「王以擅發兵擊南越，不請，故天子兵來誅。
units.literal: His younger brother Yu Shan then plotted with the chancellor and the clansmen, saying: 'The king launched an unauthorized attack on Nanyue without requesting permission, so the Son of Heaven's troops have come to punish him.
units.idiomatic: His younger brother, Yu Shan, conspired with the chancellor and their kinsmen, saying: 'The king attacked Nanyue without imperial permission, and that is why the emperor's armies have come to punish him.

units.zh: 今漢兵眾彊，今即幸勝之，后來益多，終滅國而止。
units.literal: Now the Han troops are numerous and strong; even if we are fortunate enough to defeat them now, more will come later, and it will only end with the destruction of our kingdom.
units.idiomatic: The Han armies are vast and powerful. Even if we were lucky enough to repel them today, they would only send more, and in the end our kingdom would be destroyed.

units.zh: 今殺王以謝天子。
units.literal: Let us now kill the king to apologize to the Son of Heaven.
units.idiomatic: Let us kill the king and apologize to the emperor.

units.zh: 天子聽，罷兵，固一國完；
units.literal: If the Son of Heaven accepts, he will withdraw the troops, and surely the kingdom will be preserved intact;
units.idiomatic: If the emperor accepts, he will withdraw his forces, and the kingdom can be preserved;

units.zh: 不聽，乃力戰；
units.literal: If he does not accept, then we fight with all our strength;
units.idiomatic: If he does not, then we fight with everything we have;

units.zh: 今王頭至，謝罪，不戰而耘，利莫大焉。」
units.literal: Now the king's head has arrived, they have apologized for their crimes, and we achieve our aim without battle—there is no greater advantage than this.'
units.idiomatic: Now that the king's head has been delivered, and they have submitted, we reap the harvest without shedding a drop of blood—there is no greater advantage.'

units.zh: 乃以便宜案兵告大農軍，而使使奉王頭馳報天子。
units.literal: He then, acting on his own discretion, halted the troops and informed the Grand Minister of Agriculture's army, while sending an envoy to present the king's head and gallop to report to the Son of Heaven.
units.idiomatic: Acting on his own authority, he halted the advance and notified the army of the Grand Minister of Agriculture, while dispatching a rider to present the king's head to the emperor.

units.zh: 詔罷兩將兵，曰：「郢等首惡，獨無諸孫繇君丑不與謀焉。」
units.literal: An edict dismissed both generals' troops, stating: 'Ying and the others were the principal offenders; only Chou, Lord Yao, the grandson of Wuzhu, did not participate in the conspiracy.'
units.idiomatic: An imperial edict ordered both armies to stand down, declaring: 'Ying and his accomplices were the chief culprits. Only Chou, Lord Yao, a grandson of Wuzhu, had no part in the conspiracy.'

units.zh: 繇王不能矯其眾持正。
units.literal: The King of Yao was unable to correct his people and maintain proper order.
units.idiomatic: The King of Yao could not correct his people and uphold proper order.

units.zh: 天子聞之，為餘善不足復興師，曰：「餘善數與郢謀亂，而後首誅郢，師得不勞。」
units.literal: When the Son of Heaven heard of this, he deemed it not worth raising troops again over Yu Shan, saying: 'Yu Shan repeatedly plotted rebellion with Ying, but then was the first to execute Ying, so the troops were spared their labor.'
units.idiomatic: When the emperor learned of this, he decided it was not worth mobilizing the army again on account of Yu Shan, remarking: 'Yu Shan plotted rebellion alongside Ying time and again, yet in the end he was the first to bring Ying to justice, sparing our forces the trouble.'

units.zh: 因立餘善為東越王，與繇王并處。
units.literal: Therefore, Yu Shan was established as the King of Dongyue, dwelling alongside the King of Yao.
units.idiomatic: And so Yu Shan was made the King of Dongyue, to rule alongside the King of Yao.

units.zh: 是時樓船將軍楊仆使使上書，願便引兵擊東越。
units.literal: At that time, the General of the Towered Ships, Yang Pu, sent an envoy to submit a memorial, requesting permission to conveniently lead his troops to attack Dongyue.
units.idiomatic: At that time, the General of the Towered Ships, Yang Pu, sent a memorial to the throne requesting permission to turn his forces against Dongyue.

units.zh: 上曰士卒勞倦，不許，罷兵，令諸校屯豫章梅領待命。
units.literal: The emperor said the soldiers were weary and exhausted, did not permit it, dismissed the troops, and ordered the various officers to encamp at Meiling in Yuzhang to await further orders.
units.idiomatic: The emperor, saying the troops were weary from their campaigns, denied the request. He ordered the army to stand down and the officers to encamp at Meiling in Yuzhang to await further orders.

units.zh: 元鼎六年秋，餘善聞樓船請誅之，漢兵臨境，且往，乃遂反，發兵距漢道。
units.literal: In the autumn of the sixth year of Yuanding, Yu Shan heard that the General of the Towered Ships had requested to execute him and that Han troops were approaching the border and about to advance, so he rebelled and sent troops to block the Han routes.
units.idiomatic: In the autumn of the sixth year of the Yuanding era, Yu Shan learned that the General of the Towered Ships had petitioned for his execution and that Han forces were massing on the border. He rose in open rebellion, sending his troops to block the roads leading into his territory.

units.zh: 餘善刻「武帝」璽自立，詐其民，為妄言。
units.literal: Yu Shan carved an imperial seal inscribed 'Martial Emperor' and proclaimed himself sovereign, deceiving his people with false pronouncements.
units.idiomatic: Yu Shan had an imperial seal carved bearing the title 'Martial Emperor' and declared himself sovereign, deceiving his people with extravagant claims.

units.zh: 天子遣橫海將軍韓說出句章，浮海從東方往；
units.literal: The Son of Heaven dispatched the General Who Crosses the Sea, Han Yue, from Gouzhang to sail across the sea and approach from the east;
units.idiomatic: The emperor dispatched the General Who Crosses the Sea, Han Yue, from Gouzhang to sail across the sea and approach from the east;

units.zh: 樓船將軍楊仆出武林；
units.literal: The General of the Towered Ships, Yang Pu, set out from Wulin;
units.idiomatic: The General of the Towered Ships, Yang Pu, marched from Wulin;

units.zh: 東越將多軍，漢兵至，棄其軍降，封為無錫侯。
units.literal: The Dongyue general Duo Jun, when the Han troops arrived, abandoned his army and surrendered, and was enfeoffed as the Marquis of Wuxi.
units.idiomatic: The Dongyue general Duo Jun abandoned his forces and surrendered when the Han troops arrived. He was enfeoffed as the Marquis of Wuxi.

units.zh: 於是天子曰東越狹多阻，閩越悍，數反覆，詔軍吏皆將其民徙處江淮閒。
units.literal: Thereupon the Son of Heaven declared that Dongyue was narrow and full of obstacles, Minyue fierce and repeatedly fickle, and decreed that the military officials should all lead the people to relocate between the Yangtze and Huai rivers.
units.idiomatic: The emperor then declared that Dongyue was narrow and full of barriers, that Minyue was fierce, and that they were repeatedly fickle. He decreed that the military officers were all to relocate their people to settle between the Yangtze and Huai rivers.

units.zh: 東越地遂虛。
units.literal: The lands of Dongyue were thus emptied.
units.idiomatic: And so the lands of Dongyue were left desolate.

units.zh: 及誅護，加之捶楚，因此遂卒。
units.literal: When Hu was executed, Ang was subjected to beating and torture and thereby died.
units.idiomatic: When Hu was put to death, Ang was beaten and flogged as well and died from it.

units.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu campaigned east, Xiuzheng attended him in the command tent; the victory bulletin on the pacification of Qi was written by Xiuzheng.

units.literal: And when Wang Jun campaigned against Wu, [9] he strove without regard for life, floated on the river ten thousand li, aimed straight at the moment, and made Sun Hao's ruler and ministers come in carts to Luoyang.
units.idiomatic: Wang Jun, ignoring death, sailed ten thousand li and brought Sun Hao to Luoyang in surrender.

units.zh: 大功亦舉，讒書驟至，內外唱和，貝錦將成，微晉武之鑒，亦幾於顛沛矣。
units.literal: Great merit was also achieved, but slanderous letters suddenly arrived; inside and outside sang together, brocade slander was about to be woven—without Jin Wu's discernment he too would nearly have been overthrown.
units.idiomatic: Yet slander nearly destroyed Wang Jun until Jin Wu saw through it.

units.zh: 每覽其事，常為痛心，聖主明王，固宜深察。
units.literal: Whenever I read these affairs I am constantly pained at heart; sage rulers and bright kings should indeed examine deeply.
units.idiomatic: Reading such cases pains me; sage rulers must judge more deeply.

units.idiomatic: In the second month Yi was made to drink poisoned wine and died.

units.zh: 三月，初以武悼后配食武帝廟。

units.idiomatic: In the third month the court for the first time paired Empress Wuzhao for joint sacrifice in Emperor Wu's ancestral temple.

units.zh: 庾翼在武昌，數有妖怪，欲移鎮樂鄉。

units.zh: 建德之後，武帝志在平齊。
units.literal: After the Jiande era, Emperor Wu set his mind on pacifying Qi.
units.idiomatic: After the Jiande era Emperor Wu turned his mind to conquering Qi.

units.zh: 孝寬乃上疏陳三策。
units.literal: Xiaokuan then submitted a memorial setting forth three strategies.
units.idiomatic: Xiaokuan submitted a memorial presenting three strategies.

units.zh: 斯則長策遠馭，坐自兼并也。
units.literal: This then is the long plan and distant governance—sitting and merging by oneself.
units.idiomatic: That is the long strategy: govern from afar and absorb them without stirring.

units.zh: 書奏，武帝遣小司寇淮南西元
units.literal: The memorial was submitted; Emperor Wu sent Junior Minister of Crime Huainan Xi Yuan
units.idiomatic: When the memorial was in, Emperor Wu sent Junior Minister of Crime Yuan

units.literal: (Wei) [emended variant]
units.idiomatic: [Textual note: Wei]

units.zh: 帝曰：「往已面申本懷，何煩重請也。」
units.literal: The emperor said: "You have already stated your intent to me in person — why trouble yourself with repeated requests?"
units.idiomatic: The emperor said, "You already told me your mind face to face — why ask again?"

units.zh: 五年，帝東伐，過幸玉壁。
units.literal: In the fifth year the emperor marched east; passing through, he visited Yubi.
units.idiomatic: In the fifth year Emperor Wu marched east and, passing through, visited Yubi.

units.zh: 觀禦敵之所，深嘆羨之，移時乃去。
units.literal: He viewed the places where the enemy had been held at bay, sighed deeply in admiration, and only after a long while departed.
units.idiomatic: He inspected the enemy's old defenses, sighed in deep admiration, and lingered a long while before leaving.

units.zh: 孝寬克其四城。
units.literal: Xiaokuan captured four of their cities.
units.idiomatic: Xiaokuan took four of their cities.

units.zh: 武帝平晉州，復令孝寬還舊鎮。
units.literal: When Emperor Wu pacified Jin Province, he again ordered Xiaokuan back to his old garrison.
units.idiomatic: After Emperor Wu took Jin Province, Xiaokuan was sent back to his former post.

units.zh: 及帝凱還，復幸玉壁。
units.literal: When the emperor returned in triumph, he again visited Yubi.
units.idiomatic: On his triumphant return the emperor visited Yubi again.

units.idiomatic: August Emperor Wen died.

units.zh: 十二月，武帝受魏禪。

units.idiomatic: December Sima Yan accepted Wei abdication.

units.idiomatic: Jin the fourth year of Taishi comet in Chariot.

units.zh: 占曰：「為兵喪，軫又楚分野。」
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be armies and mourning; Chariot is Chu’s field.
units.idiomatic: The prognostication said, "It means war and mourning, and Chariot is also the allotment of Chu."

units.zh: 占如上。
units.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.
units.idiomatic: Same gloss.

units.zh: 紫宮，天子內宮。
units.literal: Purple Forbidden is the Son of Heaven’s inner palace.
units.idiomatic: Purple Palace equals throne enclosure.

units.zh: 十年，武元楊皇后崩。
units.literal: In the tenth year Empress Wu Yuan Yang died.
units.idiomatic: Tenth year Yang empress died.

units.zh: 咸寧二年六月甲戌，星孛於氐。
units.literal: On jiaxu in Xianning 2 sixth month a broom star appeared at Base.
units.idiomatic: Xianning 2 June comet at Base.

units.zh: 占曰：「天子失德易政。
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Son of Heaven loses virtue and governance shifts.
units.idiomatic: The prognostication said, "The Son of Heaven loses virtue and government changes.

units.zh: 氐，又兗州分。」
units.literal: Base moreover marks Yanzhou.
units.idiomatic: Base is also the allotment of Yanzhou."

units.zh: 八月，星孛太微，至翼、北斗、三台。
units.literal: In the eighth month a broom star crossed Supreme Palace reaching Wings, Dipper, Three Steps.
units.idiomatic: August comet through palace asterisms.

units.zh: 占曰：「太微，天子庭，大人惡之。」
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Supreme Palace is the Son of Heaven’s courtyard—great men dread it.
units.idiomatic: The prognostication said, "The Supreme Palace is the Son of Heaven’s court, and great men hate it."

units.zh: 一曰：「有改王。

units.idiomatic: One reading said, "There will be a changed king.

units.zh: 天戒若曰，閶闔門非雉所止，猶殷宗雉登鼎耳之戒也。
units.literal: Heaven warns: Changhe Gate is no place for pheasants — like Shang's pheasant on the cauldron ear.
units.idiomatic: The gate omen recalled Shang dynasty precedent.

units.zh: 京房《易傳》曰：「山見葆，江於邑，邑有兵，狀如人頭，赤色。」
units.literal: Jing Fang says: "Mountain shows treasure, river in town, town has arms, shape like human head, red."
units.idiomatic: Jing Fang says: "Mountain shows treasure, river in town, town has arms, shape like human head, red."

units.zh: 武帝太康五年四月壬子，魯國池水變赤如血。
units.literal: In the fourth month of Taikang 5 under Emperor Wu, on renzi day, the pond water in Lu Principality turned red like blood.
units.idiomatic: In Emperor Wu's Taikang 5.4, on renzi, Lu's ponds turned blood-red.

units.zh: 七年十月，河陰有赤雪二頃。
units.literal: Seventh year tenth month — Heyin had two qing of red snow.
units.idiomatic: Crimson snow covered Heyin fields.

units.zh: 此赤祥也。
units.literal: This was red omen.
units.idiomatic: The crimson fall matched chi portents.

units.zh: 是後四載而帝崩，王室遂亂。
units.literal: Four years later the emperor died; the royal house then fell into chaos.
units.idiomatic: Sima Yan perished; turmoil followed.

units.zh: 惠帝元康五年三月，呂縣有流血，東西百餘步，此赤祥也。
units.literal: Emperor Hui, Yuankang 5, third month — there was flowing blood in Lü county, stretching more than a hundred paces east to west; this was a red omen.
units.idiomatic: In the third month of Yuankang 5 under Emperor Hui, blood flowed across more than a hundred paces of Lü county, a red omen.

units.zh: 景帝崩，喪事制度又依宣帝故事。
units.literal: When Emperor Jing died, the funeral regulations again followed Emperor Xuan's precedent.
units.idiomatic: Sima Shi's obsequies copied Sima Yi's lean model.

units.zh: 武帝泰始四年，文明王皇后崩，將合葬，開崇陽陵，使太尉司馬望奉祭，進皇帝密璽綬于便房神坐。
units.literal: In the fourth year of Taishi under Emperor Wu, when Empress Wenming Wang died and was about to be jointly buried, Chongyang Mausoleum was opened, Grand Commandant Sima Wang was sent to present sacrifice, and the emperor's sealed jade seal and cords were advanced to the spirit seat in the side chamber.
units.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Taishi under Emperor Wu, when Empress Wenming Wang died and was about to be jointly buried, Chongyang Mausoleum was opened, Grand Commandant Sima Wang was sent to present sacrifice, and the emperor's sealed jade seal and cords were advanced to the spirit seat in the side chamber.

units.zh: 魏氏金璽，此又儉矣。
units.literal: Wei's gold seal—another mark of frugality.
units.idiomatic: Even the golden seal bespoke restraint.

units.zh: 於是景、文遵旨。
units.literal: Jing and Wen obeyed that order.
units.idiomatic: Sima Shi and Sima Zhao complied.

units.zh: 至武帝，猶再謁崇陽陵，一謁峻平陵，然遂不敢謁高原陵，至惠帝復止也。
units.literal: Emperor Wu still visited Chongyang twice and Junping once, yet never dared approach Gaoling; under Emperor Hui the custom lapsed again.
units.idiomatic: Sima Yan alone made limited visits, never to Cao Cao's mound, and Hui abandoned the habit entirely.

units.zh: 逮于江左，元帝崩後，諸公始有謁陵辭告之事。
units.literal: After the move south of the Yangzi, not until Emperor Yuan died did high nobles begin visiting mausoleums to announce their leave-takings.
units.idiomatic: Eastern Jin nobles only began tomb pilgrimages after Sima Rui's death.
